limitations: This audit recomputes byte hashes and coverage from actual local files. It checks reader confirmations and their recorded ranges, but it does not replay the other agents tool-output transcripts or claim a new full semantic read of all 16 files by this auditor.

Reader B and Reader C did not store a prior local SHA-256. This audit records their current SHA-256 values and verifies exact content through the pinned Git blob after accounting for one added trailing LF. The architect stored three prior SHA-256 values, all checked directly.

The architect ledger defines line coverage through its total_lines, inclusive consecutive line ranges, and complete_processing_statement rather than a separate range_convention field. This audit normalizes those ranges to exact character offsets.

The pass establishes complete recorded reading of the pinned offline snapshots. It does not validate current installed HOI4 syntax, engine version, vanilla consumers, MCP service availability, production rendering, or live-game behavior.
